children.value: This project develops a machine learning application to monitor historical tree-cover loss across Brazil’s 27 subnational regions (2001–2022), predict future annual forest loss, estimate associated carbon emissions, and assign transparent deforestation-risk categories. The application is powered by Global Forest Change (GFW) data derived from Landsat satellite imagery (Hansen et al., 2013) and presents results through an interactive Streamlit dashboard.

The Historical Baseline (previous year’s loss as prediction) achieves the lowest MAE, which reflects the strong year-to-year persistence of deforestation patterns. This is common in short time-series settings where recent history is the best predictor.
